observations: Industrial straight stitch sewing machine mounted on a dedicated stand.
The brand 'TWO LION' is printed in red on the machine arm in photo 0.
An integrated electronic control panel with a blue digital display is visible on the right side of the head in photo 0.
The machine's built-in LED work light is on, indicating it is connected to power.
The assembly includes a table with a printed ruler, a foot pedal, and a thread stand.
The machine head has a large rear housing typical of direct-drive motors.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible in photo 0, but the model number TL91 is not legible.
The needle and presser foot configuration in photo 0 is standard for straight stitch machines.

risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing through multiple layers of denim or heavy fabric.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical wear or missing bobbin parts
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bobbin area and the hook assembly under the slide plate.
A photo showing the included bobbins, needles, oil bottle, and tools.

proof_requests: A clear, close-up photo of the metal model identification plate on the machine head.
A video of the machine powered on and sewing a test piece of fabric.
A photo of the underside of the table to confirm the motor type.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed, but the specific model number is unreadable. In industrial machines, the model determines critical features like automatic thread trimming and motor type which significantly impact the price.
